title: Mātṛkā pathway syllabus (per VISION-matrika-pathway)
source: docs/VISION-matrika-pathway.md (owner verbatim). Reference implementation pattern: Sivananda syllabus.

grades.title: Grade 0 · Round the body with sound
grades.text: 50 phonemes in order, each with its locus
grades.body: Head → limbs → torso → deep, Mātṛkā order
grades.visual: glyph lights + locus readout + clip; repeat aloud
grades.graduation: Follow the full round without losing place.

grades.title: Grade 1 · Phonemes alone
grades.text: Same order, sound only — no locus shown
grades.practice: mantra.html full-50, cover the locus line; lab taps with eyes closed after
grades.visual: glyph + clip only; feel the locus unshown
grades.graduation: Every clip lands somewhere felt, no chart.

grades.title: Grade 2 · Body part only
grades.visual: locus highlight → answer → reference clip confirms

grades.title: Grade 3 · Seed trajectories
grades.text: AUṀ (a+u+ṃ) then SO’HAṂ (sa out, haṃ in)
grades.visual: component flashes in time + ascent/return pulses
grades.graduation: Run both trajectories from memory, in time.

grades.title: Grade 4 · Full mantras
grades.text: OṂ (11 stations) then oṃ namaḥ śivāya (both maps)
grades.graduation: Chant either mantra with light locked to sound, eyes open or closed.
